## Progress

- Merged [PR #6](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/6) and updated in [PR #29](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/29): @medvya/i18n (en/hi/ar), RTL via html dir + logical utilities, self-hosted fonts, jsx-no-literals lint
- Follow-up: native-speaker review of hi/ar; Arabic recording-consent text waits for legal review (MDV-P3-023)

## Description

packages/i18n with ICU message format, keys from Handoff microcopy (ai.badge, note.signBlocked, consent.declined, result.received, msg.delivered, pay.pending, ai.unavailable, err.403, push.generic …). Locale switch en/hi/ar; Arabic switches MUI to RTL (stylis RTL plugin, logical properties), Noto Sans Arabic font, flipped directional icons. Brand name "Medvya" comes from a single key so the working name can be replaced globally.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Switching to Arabic flips layout direction for the whole app shell and the gallery without visual overlap (Playwright screenshot test at 360 and 1280 px).
- [ ] **AC2.** No user-facing string is hard-coded in components (lint rule fails on JSX text literals outside i18n).
- [ ] **AC3.** Missing translation keys fall back to English and are reported in CI.
- [ ] **AC4.** Handoff microcopy keys exist with the exact English text from docs/02-design/components-theme-copy.md.
- [ ] **AC5.** Numbers, dates and currency format per locale and country (₹ with Indian grouping, AED).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
